name: Adela
source:
Owner of the gallery that features Camille’s art, as well as a skilled curator and saleswoman. Sharp-tongued and just a little condescending, Adela seems quite happy with how things currently are— no doubt thanks to the revenue Camille’s work is bringing her. 

[From [url=https://blank-house.itch.io/that-which-surrounds]itch.io[/url]]
